policy.rule: No title advances past the rights gate without title-specific evidence for the exact underlying work/source edition.
policy.current_public_domain_reference: U.S. Copyright Office states works published in the United States before January 1, 1931 are in the public domain.

text_fidelity.invariant: The canonical book body is immutable after source lock.
allowed: exclude non-book source wrapper before the canonical lock when boundaries are explicitly recorded
CSS/layout outside the canonical text bytes
chapter/paragraph segmentation by immutable source offsets
narration segmentation by immutable source offsets
text_fidelity.release_requirement: No full-text or paid edition may release unless the canonical source is locked and all production text reconstructs exactly to the canonical bytes.
text_fidelity.narration_requirement: Narration input must be drawn directly from the immutable canonical text; no rewritten narration script.

rights_evidence.legal_baseline: U.S. Copyright Office Circular 15A: works published in the United States before January 1, 1931 are in the public domain.
rights_evidence.source_policy: Use only exact source ebooks whose current Project Gutenberg catalog/embedded license marks the work unrestricted/public-domain in the USA. Strip Project Gutenberg trademark/license wrapper before commercial JakeAI edition production.
